name: Quantum Computing
tagline: A textbook binary-bet theme: a tiny pure-play universe, pre-profit names that swing 30%+ on a single milestone, and a flagship fund that's really 'quantum + machine learning'.
universe_note: As of mid-2026 there are roughly 3-4 US-listed ETFs with a genuine quantum focus (QTUM, WQTM, and the AI+quantum hybrid CHPX), plus more in registration. New funds launch often — use the 'Add ticker' box on the page to pull any fund not listed here live.
key_tensions: Thin universe: only a handful of US-listed quantum ETFs, and only TWO are arguably pure-play (QTUM, WQTM). Scarcity itself is the finding.
QTUM's name says 'quantum' but its index is 'Quantum Computing AND Machine Learning' — heavily padded with IBM, NVIDIA, Alphabet, Amazon. Theme purity is diluted by design.
WQTM is purer quantum but tiny (~$26M AUM) and brand new (Oct 2025) — real closure & no-track-record risk.
CHPX blends AI-semiconductors with quantum — even less of a pure quantum bet, more an 'AI compute' play.
The underlying pure-plays (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) are extremely volatile and mostly pre-profit — binary single-stock risk flows straight through to the ETF.
Data quality: aggregators reported QTUM top holdings at ~13% each, contradicting its modified-equal-weight ~2% cap (per SEC NPORT + issuer). Always cross-check.
benchmark_note: SOXX (semiconductors) is included as a yardstick, NOT a quantum fund. Much quantum 'exposure' is really semis/AI; comparing shows how much pure-quantum you actually gain (and what you give up in liquidity).

etfs.name: Defiance Quantum ETF

performance.note: As of 06/2026 the top names are SEMICONDUCTORS (Micron, Intel, MediaTek), not quantum pure-plays — confirms the ~2-3% equal-weight cap and the 'quantum + ML + semis' character. YTD +46%.

cost.note: 0.40% — cheapest in the theme and reasonable for a thematic fund.

purity.note: Index is 'Quantum AND Machine Learning'; big-tech (IBM/NVDA/GOOGL/AMZN) dilutes the pure-quantum bet.

concentration.note: Modified equal-weight caps names near 2% across ~84 holdings — well spread.

liquidity.note: ~$4.3-5B AUM, highly liquid; the established choice.

track_record.note: Live since 2018 — longest record in the theme; beat Nasdaq-100 in 2024 & 2025.

etfs.overall: The liquid, diversified, big-tech-diluted way to play quantum.

memo.thesis: A diversified, liquid basket spanning the quantum + machine-learning supply chain. You get genuine pure-play exposure (IONQ, RGTI, D-Wave) but capped near 2% each, cushioned by mega-cap tech — lower volatility than the names themselves, at the cost of diluted 'purity'.
memo.strategy: Passively tracks the BlueStar Quantum Computing & Machine Learning Index using a MODIFIED EQUAL-WEIGHT method that caps single-name weights near 2% and rebalances semi-annually. No active manager; the index rulebook drives everything. The index explicitly includes machine-learning/enabling-tech names, not just quantum.

purity_verdict.text: Holds the real quantum pure-plays but surrounds them with IBM, NVIDIA, Intel, Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft. You're buying 'quantum + AI infrastructure', not pure quantum.

memo.concentration: Low single-name risk by design (~2% cap, ~84 names). But the whole basket is high-beta: when IONQ/RGTI move 30% on a headline, the fund still feels it.
memo.sector_geo: Tech-heavy (semis + software + mega-cap), mostly US with some international. Overlaps heavily with semiconductor and AI ETFs — watch for double-counting if you also hold SOXX/AI funds.
memo.cost_context: 0.40% is the cheapest quantum option and fair for a thematic ETF. You pay less than WQTM (0.45%) for far more liquidity.
memo.track_record_note: Since 2018; +50.5% in 2024 and +36.7% in 2025, both ahead of the Nasdaq-100. Verify trailing 3/5-yr and max drawdown via Refresh.
red_flags: ⚠️ Theme purity: 'quantum' name, but index includes machine learning + mega-cap tech.
⚠️ High beta: diversification within the theme doesn't remove the theme's own volatility.
❓ Data: aggregators showed ~13% top weights that contradict the ~2% cap — verify on issuer full-holdings + SEC NPORT.
bear: Not a pure quantum bet — heavy big-tech/ML dilution
Overlaps semis/AI ETFs you may own

decision_log.text: Before acting: verify top-10 vs SEC NPORT (resolve the ~2% vs ~13% conflict), pull drawdown, and decide if you want pure quantum (→ WQTM) or diluted-but-liquid quantum (→ QTUM).
